rules.hubs: concept linked to ≥ 2 plants by live sourced claims
rules.variation: same plant + facet, two claims with different stated conditions (or cultivar equal) and non-overlapping values
rules.disagreement: same plant + facet + same conditions (or none stated), different sources, non-overlapping values; ordinal facets only for categorical values
rules.gaps: (a) plant with no live claim on a gate facet; (b) plant–concept link with one source; (c) two plants sharing ≥ 5 concepts with no live relation
rules.single_voice: concept whose links all come from one source type

plant:acer-palmatum.text: Acer palmatum is linked to 58 concepts across 20 facets from 49 claims; sources disagree on height class, spread class, water; missing gate facets: ecology.

plant:gaultheria-shallon.text: Gaultheria shallon is linked to 53 concepts across 19 facets from 35 claims; sources disagree on exposure, water; height class depends on conditions; missing gate facets: maintenance.

plant:vaccinium-ovatum.text: Vaccinium ovatum is linked to 55 concepts across 22 facets from 41 claims; sources disagree on exposure, height class, water; missing gate facets: ecology.

variation.text: Gaultheria shallon height class depends on conditions: Oregon State gives ≤ 0.6 m under full sun, rocky or gravelly or dry, Oregon State gives 1.2–3 m under shade, humus rich.

disagreement.text: Sources disagree on Acer palmatum height class (Osakazuki): City of Vancouver trees says median 7.6 m, Great Plant Picks says 6.1 m, both no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Acer palmatum height class (Osakazuki): City of Vancouver trees says median 7.6 m, RHS says 2.5–4 m, both no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Acer palmatum height class (Osakazuki): Great Plant Picks says 6.1 m, RHS says 2.5–4 m, both no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Acer palmatum spread class (Osakazuki): Great Plant Picks says 6.1 m, RHS says 2.5–4 m, both no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Acer palmatum water: Missouri BG says average, RHS says moist, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Gaultheria shallon exposure: E-Flora BC says Filtered shade, Deep shade, Part sun/part shade, USDA PLANTS says Full sun, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Gaultheria shallon exposure: RHS says Deep shade, Part sun/part shade, Sheltered, USDA PLANTS says Full sun, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Gaultheria shallon water: RHS says average, USDA PLANTS says moist, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Vaccinium ovatum exposure: survey respondent 03 says Part sun/part shade, Filtered shade, USDA PLANTS says Full sun, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Vaccinium ovatum height class: Great Plant Picks says 2.44 m, Oregon State says 0.9–1.5 m, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Vaccinium ovatum height class: Great Plant Picks says 2.44 m, RHS says 1–1.5 m, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Vaccinium ovatum height class: Oregon State says 0.9–1.5 m, USDA PLANTS says 2.4 m, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Vaccinium ovatum height class: RHS says 1–1.5 m, USDA PLANTS says 2.4 m, both with no condition stated.
Sources disagree on Vaccinium ovatum water: Great Plant Picks says average, RHS says moist, both with no condition stated.
